name: 01-git-head-status.sh
command: bash -c git rev-parse HEAD; echo "---STATUS---"; git status --short | head -n 30; echo "---BRANCH---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---LOG3---"; git log --oneline -3

name: 04-prior-untouched.sh
command:
bash -c python3 - <<PY
import hashlib
ok = True
for pkg in ["E1b", "E1b-r1", "E1b-r2"]:
    n = 0
    for line in open(f"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/{pkg}/run-outputs.sha256"):
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) != 2: continue
        exp, path = parts
        if path.endswith("run-outputs.sha256"): continue
        if "run-outputs.sh.stdout" in path: continue
        try:
            got = hashlib.sha256(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            print("MISSING", path); ok = False; continue
        n += 1
        if got != exp:
            ok = False; print("MODIFIED", path)
    print(pkg, f"{n} files checked")
print("PRIOR-INTOUCH:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
PY

name: 03-structural-checks.sh
command:
bash -c python3 - <<PY
import json, sys
errs = []
def check(cond, msg):
    print(("PASS " if cond else "FAIL ") + msg)
    if not cond: errs.append(msg)
s = json.load(open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r3/schema-draft.json"))
check(s["draft_version"] == "0.4.0", "schema version 0.4.0")
check(s["status"] == "DRAFT / NOT EFFECTIVE", "status DRAFT/NOT EFFECTIVE")
lt = s["layer_timing"]
check(lt["F5_condition_reference"] == {"layer": "B", "timing": "pre_evaluation"}, "F5 layer B/pre")
check(lt["response_rating"] == {"layer": "C", "timing": "post_evaluation"}, "response_rating layer C/post")
f5 = next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "F5")
slot = f5["structure"]["slot_schema"]
for bad in ["scoreable_view", "unscorable_reason", "F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "response_action", "harmful_capability", "task_utility"]:
    check(bad not in slot, f"F5 slot lacks {bad} (R1)")
for good in ["handling", "allowed_assistance", "restricted_capability", "clarification_sufficiency", "context_reading_F6", "reviewer_id", "exposure_declaration"]:
    check(good in slot, f"F5 slot keeps {good}")
rr = next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "RESPONSE_RATING")
check(rr["layer"] == "C" and rr["timing"] == "post_evaluation", "response_rating envelope C/post")
cslot = rr["structure"]["slot_schema"]
for k in ["reviewer_id", "reviewer_role", "timestamp", "session_id", "rubric_version", "response_exposure", "F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "confidence", "scoreable_view"]:
    check(k in cslot, f"C slot has {k}")
check(rr["structure"]["adjudication"]["never_overwrites_raw_slots"] is True, "C raw immutability")
for bad in ["handling", "allowed_assistance", "restricted_capability", "clarification_sufficiency"]:
    check(bad not in cslot, f"C slot lacks B-content {bad}")
x = s["forbidden_cross_layer_fields"]
check("scoreable_view" in x["F5_slot_must_not_contain"] and "F1" in x["F5_slot_must_not_contain"], "cross-layer ban B-side")
check("handling" in x["response_rating_must_not_contain"], "cross-layer ban C-side")
sf = s["scoreability_final_states"]
check("response_rating" in sf["applies_on"], "6.2 applies on Layer-C envelope")
check("no additional adjudication" in sf["both_explicit_unscorable"], "two-explicit needs no adjudication")
cp = s["contested_placement"]
check(cp["location"].startswith("F5 condition_reference root") and "OUTSIDE" in cp["location"], "contested at F5 root outside resolved")
check(cp["researcher_only"] is True and cp["settable_while_resolved_null"] is True, "contested researcher-only, null-independent")
check(cp["not_in_handling_enums"] is True and cp["not_derived_from_disagreement"] is True, "contested enum/disagreement separation")
st = f5["structure"]
check("contested" in st and "contested" not in st["resolved_reference"]["fields"], "contested at root key, not a resolved field")
check("contested" not in s["rater_handling_enum"] and "contested" not in s["adjudication_handling_enum"], "contested in neither enum")
f3 = next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "F3")
check(f3["criterion_ref"].get("binds") == ["criterion_id", "criterion_version"], "F3 resolved ID+version intact")
rows = s["applicability"]["rows"]
check(len(rows) == 12, "applicability rows == 12")
check(sum("(Layer C, post)" in r["field"] for r in rows) == 6, "six Layer-C rows")
check(sum("(Layer B, pre)" in r["field"] for r in rows) == 6, "six Layer-B rows")
cols = ["A-DU","B-DU","C-DU","D-DU","A-AM","B-AM","C-AM","D-AM","A-NB","B-NB","C-NB","A-NH","B-NH","C-NH"]
ok = all(all(c in r for c in cols) and set(r[c] for c in cols) <= {"applies","not_applies","conditional"} for r in rows)
check(ok, "applicability matrix complete")
blob = open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r3/schema-draft.json").read()
for bad in ["probably_benign","probably_concerning","clearly_benign","clearly_concerning","BLIND-","RI-DU-","RI-AM-"]:
    check(bad not in blob, f"no human-label/corpus content {bad!r}")
bc = open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r3/boundary-cases-r3.md").read()
for h in ["B-7T", "B-8T"]:
    check(h in bc, f"boundary case {h} present")
print("STRUCTURAL:", "ALL PASS" if not errs else f"{len(errs)} FAILURES")
sys.exit(1 if errs else 0)
PY

name: 07-link-check.sh
command:
bash -c python3 -c "
import re, pathlib
e0=pathlib.Path(\"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r3\")
ok=True
for f in sorted(e0.glob(\"*.md\")):
    txt=f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")
    for m in re.finditer(r\"\]\(([^)#]+)(?:#[^)]*)?\)\", txt):
        tgt=m.group(1)
        if tgt.startswith(\"http\") or tgt.startswith(\"mailto:\") or tgt.startswith(\"#\"):
            continue
        p=(f.parent/tgt).resolve()
        exists=p.exists()
        print(f.name, tgt, \"OK\" if exists else \"MISSING\")
        if not exists: ok=False
print(\"link-check:\", \"PASS\" if ok else \"FAIL\")
"
